summary: Bioforce Nanosciences Holdings, Inc. disclosed via Form 8-K that on September 28, 2026 it received an assignment of the Liberty Lease from the State of Texas General Land Office, covering approximately 40.19 acres of mineral estate in Liberty County, Texas (GLO Mineral File/Lease No. MF121453, Parcel C). The assignor was affiliate CELT eResources, LLC, both controlled by Nexus Capital Investments, Inc., a related-party transfer; the Liberty County Clerk approved the assignment on October 2, 2026 for GLO recording. Bioforce assumed all lease obligations, wells, and equipment. No price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation was stated. Watch for related-party conflict and funding risk given the micro-cap shell profile.
